# `aube access set`

- **Usage:** `aube access set <SETTING> <PACKAGE>`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Set package visibility or a publish MFA requirement.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/publishing) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<SETTING>`** — `status=public|private|restricted` or `mfa=none|publish|automation`.
- **`<PACKAGE>`** — Package name.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
